notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored (deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run wC-084) and unreviewed; this package has no hardware backend and no hardware run was made. The card's entry symbol B1Env.b1_env:B1Sim was verified at B1Env/b1_env.py:19 (class B1Sim(Env)); native is that symbol and the task card was not edited. No helper deviation: the GymnasiumDriver family fits the environment's spaces and derives cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 from them. Deviations from the card's mock preference: the card prefers an upstream simulator, but B1Sim is not registered with gymnasium (the clone calls no register), imports pybullet, gymnasium, numpy and pinocchio (B1Env/b1_env.py:3-16, :54-55), and its reset and step return only the info dict {'q','dq'} (B1Env/b1_env.py:118-121 and :132-138), which is not the Gymnasium (observation, info) / five-tuple the bridge unpacks. The clone was never imported or run (no network and its dependencies are not installed), so backends has only the package fake (.fake:FakeB1Sim), there is no env_id / implicit gymnasium.make path, and the upstream PyBullet environment was not run. The pure-Python fake is a per-joint kinematic stand-in built from the same URDF spaces (b1_env.py:69-95); it converts q+dq into the 24-element observation and returns reward 0 with terminated/truncated false so the bridge can serve the environment, and this adaptation is disclosed in fidelity.gaps and the fake docstring. The fake was never compared with the upstream simulator. Also disclosed: the upstream reset zeroes only the 12 actuated joints and not the floating base, so reset is partial and determinism is declared none; the knee upper limit -0.6 (b1_raw.urdf:176) makes the 0.0 reset angle outside the observation Box for the four knees. Not covered: rendering (render_mode human, b1_env.py:31-34) because cap.world.* binds no render class. The observation array is carried at its real size (24 values) and the action at its real size (12 joint torques); no array is truncated. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. Warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only arms the next reset, so it makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived inputs (seed on reset, seed on seed, ticks and action.values[*]) are the expected Gymnasium family warnings; G4 reported no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest line the check printed (the check report without its clock).
